title: Ligustilide and tectoridin from Danggui Buxue Decoction synergistically attenuate atherosclerosis by targeting the CD36/TRPM2 axis and TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Li, Xin; Zheng, Shu; Song, Yuqiong; Chen, Xue; Zhang, Yanqiu; Li, Ming; Zhang, Hao
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药当归补血汤成分通过CD36/TRPM2/TNF-alpha通路抗动脉粥样硬化，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atherosclerosis (AS) is a common chronic disease and the primary pathological basis for myocardial infarction, stroke, and other disabling conditions. Danggui Buxue Decoction (DBD) is a classic formula in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) normally used for deficiency patterns. However, whether DBD can alleviate atherosclerosis, which bioactive constituents are responsible, and which molecular mechanisms are involved remain to be further investigated. PURPOSE: This study aims to characterize the absorbed bioactive components of DBD and decipher the multi-target mechanisms by which it counteracts atherosclerosis, providing a scientific rationale for its clinical application. METHODS: This study employs an integrated approach combining network pharmacology, WGCNA, and machine learning screening strategies, supported by experimental validation, to systematically elucidate the active pharmaceutical ingredients and molecular mechanisms of anti-AS effects of serum-absorbed constituents of DBD after oral administration. RESULTS: Network pharmacology and machine learning analyses predicted CD36, TRPM2, and TNF-alpha as three core targets for DBD intervention in AS. CETSA and BLI experiments further confirmed stable binding of Ligustilide and Tectoridin in DBD to these targets. In vivo and in vitro experiments demonstrated that the combined treatment of Ligustilide and Tectoridin effectively inhibit macrophage foaming, mitigate oxidative damage, and downregulate inflammatory cytokine release. CONCLUSION: This study successfully identified Ligustilide and Tectoridin as the primary bioactive constituents of DBD against atherosclerosis. By modulating CD36, TRPM2, and TNF-alpha, these compounds synergistically inhibit foam cell formation and inflammation, offering a novel pharmacological perspective on the anti-AS efficacy of DBD.
abstract_zh: 背景：动脉粥样硬化（Atherosclerosis, AS）是一种常见的慢性疾病，也是心肌梗死、中风及其他致残性疾病的主要病理基础。当归补血汤（Danggui Buxue Decoction, DBD）是中医（Traditional Chinese Medicine, TCM）中常用于虚证的经典方剂。然而，DBD是否能缓解动脉粥样硬化、其起效的生物活性成分是什么，以及涉及哪些分子机制，仍有待进一步研究。目的：本研究旨在表征DBD吸收后的生物活性成分，并解析其对抗动脉粥样硬化的多靶点机制，为其临床应用提供科学依据。方法：本研究采用整合网络药理学、WGCNA和机器学习筛选策略的综合方法，并辅以实验验证，系统阐明口服DBD后血清吸收成分的抗AS活性药物成分及分子机制。结果：网络药理学和机器学习分析预测CD36、TRPM2和TNF-α为DBD干预AS的三个核心靶点。CETSA和BLI实验进一步证实DBD中的藁本内酯（Ligustilide）和鸢尾苷（Tectoridin）能稳定结合这些靶点。体内和体外实验表明，藁本内酯和鸢尾苷联合治疗能有效抑制巨噬细胞泡沫化、减轻氧化损伤，并下调炎症细胞因子释放。结论：本研究成功鉴定藁本内酯和鸢尾苷为DBD抗动脉粥样硬化的主要生物活性成分。通过调节CD36、TRPM2和TNF-α，这些化合物协同抑制泡沫细胞形成和炎症，为DBD的抗AS疗效提供了新的药理学视角。
